Sardine Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 12:46pm

Ingredients




cup Uncooked barley
1 jar (9 ¾ oz) olive salad, drained, coarsely chopped
4 cans (4 ⅜ oz size) oil-packed sardines, drained l/3 cup chopped red 
Preparation

1 Rinse barley; place in medium saucepan. Add 1 qt salted water. Heat to boiling; simmer until tender, about 40 minutes. Drain; place in large bowl. 2 Add remaining ingredients; toss gently. Chill. Garnish with lemon wedges. 3 Makes 8 servings.
